Save the parameter files used in a calibration run

keep_track_prm.Rd

Copies the parameter files used in a model run to <track.path>/iteration_<iteration>/run_<run>_<file>, so the parameters used in every run of every iteration of the calibration are kept.

Usage

keep_track_prm(path, track.path, files)

Arguments

path

Character. Directory where the model is run.

track.path

Character. Folder where the files are saved.

files

Character vector. Names of the files to save, relative to path.

Value

Invisibly, the paths of the saved files.

Details

calibrar runs each individual of the population in its own directory <control$run>/i<run>, and reuses these directories in every iteration (generation). The run number is taken from the name of the directory, and the iteration from a counter kept in the file .iteration in that directory, which is increased by one at every run. The best solution is evaluated in i0 at the end of each phase; these files are saved in <track.path>/final_<phase> instead. Outside a calibrar run directory, the run number is 0.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  keep_track_prm(getwd(), here::here("outputs", "keep_track_calibration"),
                 files = c("calibration-parameters.csv", "VMPA_setas_biol_fishing_Trunk.prm"))
} # }
